test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**originated**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term** "originated"** (उत्पन्न हुआ) means to begin or start, which fits well with the context.
 
• The context tells us that Britain is where modern football had its start in the 1800s.
 
• The other options (terminated, culminated, fragmented) do not fit the context of starting or beginning.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Terminated (समाप्त):** "Terminated" means to bring to an end, which does not fit the context of starting.
 
• **Culminated (परिणति): **"Culminated" means to reach a climax or point of highest development, which does not fit the context of starting.
 
• **Fragmented (खंडित): **"Fragmented" means to break into pieces, which does not fit the context of starting.
